## lib-enrich-observable (N8N-2.4, C6)
**Trigger:** called by playbooks (pb-generic) through Execute Workflow, after the TheHive alert was **created** (a duplicate is not re-enriched; an interrupted run's repair enriches what is left), waiting for the result.
**Inputs:** `{thehive_alert_id, wazuh_alert_id, observables: <lib-extract-observables observables, with the tags lib-misp-warninglist added>, tlp, pap, severity: <as sent to TheHive, 1-4>, enrichment_started_ms, config: <lib-config>, context}`.
**Actions taken:** (1) plan from lib-config `enrichment` (README "Enrichment policy"): never the agent's own observables or internal ranges, documentation ranges to local analyzers only, values on a MISP warninglist (tag `warninglist`, C10) to local analyzers only while `misp_warninglist.skip_online_analyzers` is true (false since 2026-10-21), a `url` to online analyzers only when it is an absolute http(s) URL with a host (X-44), TLP/PAP of the alert against each analyzer's max, disabled analyzers and unsupported dataTypes skipped, severe-path analyzers (VirusTotal, D-N7) planned last, at most `max_observables_per_alert`; (2) if any job: list Cortex analyzers (name -> id; an analyzer Cortex doesn't list is skipped `not enabled in Cortex`, no call; Cortex down shows here: every job fails `cortex_unreachable`), then one job at a time (Loop Over Items): the **Job gate** skips a severe-path analyzer unless the alert's severity >= `severe_path.min_severity` or an earlier analyzer for the same observable said suspicious/malicious (`severe path only`), and starts no job once `budget_s` have passed since `enrichment_started_ms` (`enrichment budget`, D-N8; a job in flight finishes); the others run through lib-cortex-job; (3) reduce each report's taxonomies to a verdict (worst wins, per-analyzer overrides); (4) for each enriched observable, look up its TheHive id (`getAlert` -> `observables` query) and add tags `asox:verdict=<verdict>`, `analyzer:<name>`, plus `ioc: true` only for a malicious verdict, through lib-thehive-tag-observable.
**Never** parks the alert, lowers severity, closes or suppresses anything (D12): failures and skips are returned per observable for the writeback (`counts.skipped_runs` by reason, `budget`, `job_log`).
**Systems changed:** TheHive (observable tags and IOC flag); Cortex runs read-only lookups.
**Approval:** not needed (no system changes outside TheHive).
**Owner:** n8n.
Successful executions are not saved (N8N-6.5): pb-generic's execution holds the result.
